name: youtube_search_first_video
intent: Search YouTube for a requested term and report the first video in the results
description: Opens Search in YouTube, runs the requested search, scrolls past any sponsored result, and returns the title of the first real video in the results.
patterns: find the first YouTube video for a query
look up a video on YouTube
what is the first result on YouTube

inputs.name: search_query
inputs.description: The term to search for on YouTube.

steps.intent: Tap the {{search_query}} suggestion to run the search
Scroll down to reveal the first real video result past the sponsored result

outputs.name: first_video_title
outputs.example: lofi hip hop radio 📚 beats to relax/study to
